integrity: The exact enumerator and asymptotic bounds have proofs and exact finite cross-checks; no independent mathematical audit, experimental proof of asymptotics, or uniqueness guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Simple undirected cycles on at least three vertices only.
No sharp leading constant for the total size and no local central limit theorem.
The fixed-deficiency estimate holds only for fixed integer deficiency.
A broader enumeration might imply this result; publication priority is not certified.
title: Partial automorphisms of cycles: exact rank enumeration and half-rank concentration
